alex: heads-up: p99 on staging spiked to ~380ms for short prompts after the kernel-fallback change this morning :eyes:

jia: saw that — timeline?

alex: root msg ts 2109999999; deploy rolled ~2109996400. baseline p99 pre-deploy ~210ms. after -> ~380ms. p95 ~120ms stable.

nate: I saw kernel fallback to the slower 'generic' kernel for sequences <128 due to the new selection heuristic. fallback path adds ~100-140ms on the tail.

sofia: KV cache hit rate also dropped from ~86% -> ~62% for this workload. suspicious — could be eviction churn + scheduling changes.

alex: current scheduler config on staging:
```
max_batch_tokens: 2048
max_wait_ms: 8
microbatch_size: 32
```

jia: low max_wait + small observed queues -> microbatches are small and kernel chooser prefers generic path. smaller microbatches increase chance of fallback.

nate: profiling snip (device-side): avg_token_ms=1.9ms, p95_token_ms=2.8ms, p99_token_ms=6.4ms; kernel-switch overhead ~40ms when fallback occurs.

alex: hypothesis: bump max_wait_ms to 12-16ms so batches collect more tokens, keep preferred optimized kernel active -> lower p99. throughput might dip a few percent.

sofia: also want to test kv_retention_ms bump (30k -> 60k) to recover hit rate. eviction + microburst patterns could explain 24% hit loss.

jia: propose two experiments (staging):
- A: max_wait_ms=16, max_batch_tokens=3072, microbatch_size=32
- B: max_wait_ms=8, microbatch_size=16, kv_retention_ms=60000
measure: p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, kernel-fallback-rate, kv-hit-rate, cost/unit.

nate: +1. please also enable lightweight logging to capture kernel-selection reason tag: fallback_reason=(kernel_mismatch|cold_kernel|small_batch).

deploy-bot: Scheduled experiment A to staging at 2110001200.

alex: i'll run synthetic burst tests (tail_small_prompts_v2) + live traffic replay.

jia: if A reduces p99 by >40ms and throughput within -5% we can roll to canary.

sofia: note: longer max_wait can increase CPU-side queueing and host CPU%. add host cpu% and queue_depth traces.

nate: i'll instrument kernel-selection histogram, kv-size histogram, and evictions/sec metric.

alex: thanks team — will post results here when experiments finish. :thumbsup:
